title: Written off Facebook ads? Try this...
description: Written off Facebook ads? Try this...
transcript: If you've written off meta video ads because you've tried that ad format before and it didn't perform very well, here's what you should do. Create one full ad, but 20 different hooks. You can easily do that with a combination of visual and verbal hooks, and that allows you to take that one ad, take the effort it requires to create one ad and a few extra hooks, and make it go that much further. Also massively increases a percentage chance that you'll find a winner, because the hook is the most important part.
